message: My father passed away last week and I miss him.
I failed my math exam and feel so stupid.
My husband and I keep arguing over small things.
I haven't prayed in months and I feel disconnected.
My parents are forcing me to study medicine.
I got the job! Alhamdulillah!
I keep sinning and repenting, I feel like a hypocrite.
I am so lonely in this new country.
My friend betrayed my trust.
I am stressed about my financial debts.
I feel like my dua is never answered.
I am struggling with my identity as a Muslim.
I broke up with my fiance.
I am jealous of my sister's success.
I feel overwhelmed with parenting.
I am worried about my sick mother.
I am being bullied at school.
I feel peace when I read Quran.
I am afraid of death.
I am struggling with intrusive thoughts during prayer.
